title: CPR-IE:A Compression-Prediction-Resource Intelligence Efficiency Metric
abstract: arXiv:2609.04809v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Comparing intelligent systems under deployment constraints requires more than predictiveaccuracy.This paper develops Compression-Prediction-Resource Intelligence Efficiency (CPR-IE) as a protocol-relative ordering by representational economy, predictive quality, and resourceburden. The analysis separates two questions-how raw resource consumption is represented, andhow the resulting attributes are aggregated. Proportional-increment composition uniquely yieldslogarithmic cumulative burden, and context-independent ratio response yields power responsesto compression, prediction, and burden; with reference normalization the representation is I(C,P,T).We prove Pareto consistency, unit invariance, boundary behavior, trade-off identities, ranking-stability regions, and cross-task aggregation. translated_title: CPR-IE：一种压缩-预测-资源智能效率度量指标
translated_abstract: 在部署约束下比较智能系统，仅靠预测精度是不够的。本文提出了压缩-预测-资源智能效率指标，作为一种基于表征经济性、预测质量与资源负担的协议相对排序方法。该分析区分了两个问题——原始资源消耗如何被表征，以及由此得到的属性如何聚合。比例增量复合唯一地产生对数形式的累积负担，而与上下文无关的比率响应则产生对压缩、预测与负担的幂律响应；通过参考归一化，该表示形式为 I(C,P,T)。作者证明了帕累托一致性、单位不变性、边界行为、权衡恒等式、排序稳定区域以及跨任务聚合等性质。一个超越对数母模型明确了交互限制，进一步的结果建立了基数与序数可识别性以及亚高斯有限样本……
tldr: 本文提出CPR-IE这一综合压缩效率、预测质量与资源负担三方面的智能效率度量指标，并证明了其帕累托一致性、单位不变性等关键数学性质，为在部署约束下公平比较智能系统提供了系统的理论框架。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CPR-IE, an intelligence efficiency metric that integrates compression, predictive quality, and resource burden, and rigorously proves key properties such as Pareto consistency and unit invariance, providing a systematic theoretical framework for fairly comparing intelligent systems under deployment constraints.
